description: Find opportunities similar to a given one using semantic similarity. Returns each result with similarityScore (0-1) and a concise matchExplanation of shared signals such as category/class, geography, organization, and award amount band. Useful when user likes one result and wants more like it. Uses vector embeddings to find conceptually related opportunities, not just keyword matches. Paid feature. Counts toward your monthly searches.

limit.description: Max similar opportunities to return (default: 5, max: 20)

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity to find similar matches for (from search results)

name: find_similar
title: Find Similar Opportunities
